name: Venomeum
description: Venomeum ($VMH) — ERC-20 with burnable tax, automatic buyback and automatic liquidity pool, trading on Venomeum Swap (own Uniswap V2) with removable liquidity. Testnet deployments.

features.burnableTax: 1% of every DEX buy/sell is burned
features.automaticLiquidity: 1% accrues and auto-adds to the liquidity pool
features.automaticBuyback: 1% accrues, auto-swaps to native and buys back + burns VMH
